notes.title: LudoNarraCon Streams and New Game Release!
notes.notes:
Hi! I'm happy to announce that A YEAR OF SPRINGS will be a part of LudoNarraCon, a digital festival celebrating narrative games! A YEAR OF SPRINGS has its biggest Steam sale yet to celebrate and a demo is also available during the event 🎉

Also, on the exact same day, I'm releasing a new game! The game is A HERO AND A GARDEN, a fantasy visual novel & gardening clicker game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914740
If you like narrative games, I hope you'll check it out! It's a cute story about a hero, a princess, and a village of monsters. 

The LudoNarraCon event goes from May 5 to May 9, and A YEAR OF SPRINGS will be doing a bunch of streams over this period to take part.

Here's the planned schedule:

May 5: Art Stream with the Dev (that's me! 👀)
May 6: Chill Demo Stream (No Commentary)
May 7: A YEAR OF SPRINGS Music Radio

Streams start every day at 4PM PT! 

You can watch the streams right from this page (I think). Hope to see you there!

notes.title: INDIE Live Expo Winter & Android Release Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello again! A YEAR OF SPRINGS was showcased in the INDIE Live Expo & is currently participating in the INDIE Live Expo Winter 2021 Sale! Don't miss this chance to get the game (& soundtrack!) for 10% off. 

The INDIE Live Expo showcased over 500 games and is viewable below. There are so many cool games in this showcase so I definitely recommend watching it. (You also get to see Shoji Meguro play a song on guitar for his new indie game!!! Seriously, don't miss it.)

en: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BiYqV3OKi00
jp: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PJQRQDG2eFI
ch: https://live.bilibili.com/22229644

To celebrate, A YEAR OF SPRINGS Is also available on Android now! Check it out below if you'd like to play on the go.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.npckc.ayos

Hope you all enjoy 💜
